comments.author: DanW
comments.body_html: I use it with Questing Bots, but presumably it can work with any of them. I haven’t tested any others.

comments.author: yosy2010
comments.body_html:
Hi! many thanks for the great mod!

anyway I can configure the percentage after the specified level/hours?

comments.author: DanW
comments.body_html:
You can use a mod like SVM to change individual boss chances, which is probably the “right” way to do it.

Alternatively, you can change the final number from 1 in the right column of chance_progression_rate to scale all boss chances, but that’ll take some experimentation.

comments.author: fatihce
comments.body_html: How can we increase it to 100% spawn chance?

comments.author: DanW
comments.body_html: This mod isn’t really intended to do that. While it’s possible, you’re better off using a mod like SVM instead.

comments.author: IZZY_1979
comments.body_html:
I’ve installed the mod and I am getting an error.

The data contract type ‘LiveLikeBossSpawnChances.Configuration.ThresholdsConfig’ cannot be deserialized becasuse the required data member ‘adjustment range’ was not found.

https://imgur.com/a/4Bc4wd4

comments.author: Excelinq
comments.body_html: Fix i used was to change “adjustmentRange” in the mods config.json to “adjustment_range”. Server boots fine after.

comments.author: IZZY_1979
comments.body_html: Thank you. That fixed it! That was logical. hehe.
